passive.name: Berserker Rage
passive.description: Olaf gains Attack Speed and Life Steal based on his missing Health.

spells.name: Undertow
spells.description: Olaf throws an axe, dealing physical damage and Slowing by % for up to seconds (based on distance travelled). Champions hit lose % Armor for seconds. If Olaf picks up the axe, this Ability's Cooldown is reduced to seconds, or fully refunded if seconds has elapsed.
spells.coverageNote: CommunityDragon calculation TotalDamage was normalized. Complex subcasts remain selectable assumptions.

spells.name: Tough It Out
spells.description: Olaf gains % Attack Speed for seconds, and plus % missing Health Shield (up to a maximum of Shield below % Health) for seconds.
spells.coverageNote: No champion damage packet is present for this cast.

spells.name: Reckless Swing
spells.description: Olaf ferociously swings his axes, dealing true damage. If the enemy dies, the cost is refunded. Attacks lower the Cooldown of this Ability by 1 second, increased to 2 seconds when attacking monsters.
spells.coverageNote: CommunityDragon calculation TotalDamage was normalized. Complex subcasts remain selectable assumptions.

spells.name: Ragnarok
spells.description: Passive: Olaf gains Armor and Magic Resist. Active: Olaf cleanses all Immobilizing and Disabling effects on himself and becomes immune to them for seconds. While active, Olaf gains Attack Damage. Hitting a champion with an Attack or Reckless Swing extends the duration by seconds. Additionally, Olaf gains % Move Speed towards enemy champions for second.
spells.coverageNote: No champion damage packet is present for this cast.
